how: The Alliance Française Paris Île-de-France runs in-person and online French courses at all levels plus workshops at its school on Boulevard Raspail.
The Korean Cultural Centre in Paris offers Korean language courses (in person at the King Sejong Institute and online) plus calligraphy and paper-craft workshops.
The Musée de la Magie in the Marais stages magic shows and offers magic courses and holiday workshops (stages).

The Société Mycologique de France, based in Paris, organises weekly field outings, monthly sessions and beginner introduction walks, plus an annual mushroom exhibition at the Parc floral de Vincennes.
World Cube Association competitions run in the Paris area (e.g. Palais Open in Palaiseau, Nov 2025 and Dec 2026), alongside the Association Française de Speedcubing.
Paris has many tattoo studios and hosts the Mondial du Tatouage, a major international tattoo convention at La Grande Halle de la Villette (30 Jan-1 Feb 2026 edition).
venue: Le Mondial du Tatouage, Grande Halle de la Villette

how: Paris Phoenix (Paris Lacrosse) trains on Saturdays 14:00-16:00 with Sixes sessions open to all and beginners welcome, and plays France/Europe competitions.
Airsoft 75 runs an outdoor airsoft ground in the Yvelines about 25 minutes from Paris, with rental replicas and equipment for day sessions.
Paris-based kite associations (Les Amis du Cerf-Volant in the 3e; Cerf-Volant Club de France, historically flying at the Polygone de Vincennes) organise kite flying and meet-ups.
venue: Cerf-Volant Club de France / Les Amis du Cerf-Volant

how: Paris Couronne Passion Disc Golf plays and welcomes members on the 18-hole permanent course at the Île de loisirs de Jablines-Annet, with tee markers for beginners.
venue: Disc golf course, Île de loisirs de Jablines-Annet

how: Raid Orientation Paris, founded 2005 with ~150 licensed members, runs orienteering training for all ages and levels and organises races (Raid O Paris).
Netball Paris trains weekly on Thursday evenings (Gymnase Commandant Mouchotte) and Sunday mornings (Gymnase Auguste Renoir), welcoming beginners to experienced players.
FPV Racing SQY, the first drone-piloting club at the Île de loisirs de Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines, offers FPV drone racing; other Paris-region FPV groups also exist.
venue: FPV Racing SQY, Île de loisirs de Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines

how: Aéromate runs a 450 m2 rooftop aeroponic urban farm in Paris 12e with 1h30 guided visits and urban-agriculture workshops for adults and children.
The Ateliers Beaux-Arts de Paris (Glacière) teach lithography on stone and alugraphy from drawing to printing to ages 16+; Idem Paris is also a historic lithographic print studio in Montparnasse.
INALCO teaches modern Tamil (licence, master, and as a minor or language option) in Paris.
Billard Club Parisien (FFB-affiliated) and Paris Snooker Club & Academy offer billiards and snooker tables, with beginners welcome and coaching.
Bagad Pariz runs weekly beginner bagpipe (cornemuse) lessons on Thursday evenings at Notre-Dame du Travail, and the Mission Bretonne hosts bagpipe classes.
IVT (International Visual Theatre) training centre teaches LSF (French Sign Language) courses for beginners and advanced learners, about 1,000 trainees a year.
GOBELINS Paris school offers a Mastère in 2D/3D animation and a Bachelor in digital creation animation at its Paris campuses (plus continuing education and Ateliers Gobelins).
The Société française de numismatique holds monthly public-interest sessions for coin and medal enthusiasts at the BnF Département des Monnaies, médailles et antiques.
venue: Société française de numismatique, BnF Richelieu

how: The Ateliers Beaux-Arts de Paris offer weekly gravure (printmaking, intaglio) workshops such as Atelier 43 with Frank Denon; Centre Paris Anim' Victoire Tinayre runs lino engraving.
The Patronage Laïque Jules-Vallès in Paris 15e offers macramé jewellery-making workshops for adults (14:00-18:00).
The City of Paris supports a network of jardins partagés (shared community gardens) run by residents' associations, with guidance on joining or creating one.
Paris provides fenced off-leash dog areas (canisites/parcs canins), e.g. a dedicated dog park opened in the 10e arrondissement.
Paris municipal Centre Paris Anim' (e.g. Beaujon, Musidora, Bessie Smith) run weekly adult Qi Gong classes, among over 100 listed sessions.
Paris diving clubs (e.g. Subaqua Club de Paris, Aqua Paris Plongée, Loisirs Plongée) hold apnée (freediving) sessions in municipal pools such as Piscine Keller and Piscine des Amiraux.
venue: Subaqua Club de Paris, Piscine des Amiraux

how: Centre Paris Anim' Dunois runs an aeromodelling workshop for ages 12+ covering building and flying miniature aircraft.
Ateliers Beaux-Arts de Paris at Glacière teach taille directe (direct carving in stone and wood) and sculpture to ages 16+ (Ateliers 38 and 39).

how: Institut Feibai in Paris 1er teaches Chinese painting and calligraphy to adults, and the Patronage Laïque Jules-Vallès runs half-day Chinese calligraphy and painting workshops.
Centre Paris Anim' Beaujon runs an eloquence (public speaking) workshop for teens and adults, which covers speaking skills rather than formal competitive debate.
Fishing is permitted in designated zones of the Bois de Boulogne/Vincennes lakes and along the Seine in Paris (state fishing licence required).
venue: Lakes of the Bois de Vincennes and Bois de Boulogne

how: The Île de loisirs de Cergy-Pontoise has an 820 m cable tow (téléski nautique) for water-skiing and wakeboarding, from age 10, with obstacle modules for advanced riders.
venue: Téléski nautique, Île de loisirs de Cergy-Pontoise

how: The Île de loisirs de Cergy-Pontoise has an 820 m cable tow (téléski nautique) for water-skiing, from age 10 and from about 9 EUR.
venue: Téléski nautique, Île de loisirs de Cergy-Pontoise

how: The Île de loisirs de Cergy-Pontoise has an 820 m cable tow (téléski nautique) for wakeboarding, from age 10 and from about 9 EUR.
venue: Téléski nautique, Île de loisirs de Cergy-Pontoise

how: The Archives de Paris (Paris 19e) hold over 13 million digitised pages of genealogical sources (civil registers etc.) searchable online and on site.
FUN MOOC, the French national platform, hosts free online university courses from French institutions; Paris universities and grandes écoles contribute many.
The association Sport Culture Ed La Star runs a pencak silat activity at the municipal Gymnase de la Cour des Lions (Paris 11e), part of the City of Paris associations' programme.
venue: Sport Culture Ed La Star, Gymnase de la Cour des Lions

how: Centre Mandapa (Paris 13e) offers Hindustani music masterclasses and Indian music and dance workshops, but no dedicated sitar course is listed.
The Pagoda of the Bois de Vincennes (Paris 12e), seat of the Union bouddhiste de France, is a working Buddhist temple housing Europe's tallest Buddha statue.
Guided wild-plant botanical walks such as the Vagabondes walk at Père-Lachaise (24 Oct 2026) teach identification of wild plants, and the City of Paris publishes a monthly free nature programme.
The City of Paris' free monthly nature programme (Maison Paris Nature at the Parc Floral and others) offers guided walks and workshops on wild fauna and flora, with insects as occasional themes.
The Île de loisirs de Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines, with a 150 ha lake, lists windsurfing (planche à voile) among its sailing activities.

The City of Paris promotes self-guided heritage routes, such as the Libération de Paris trail (from the Hôtel de Ville to the Musée de la Libération) on foot or by bike via the Détour app, and the Parcours Mémori.elles.
Independent record shops such as Dizonord (rue André-Messager, Paris 18e) sell vinyl; the City of Paris subsidises record shops among cultural businesses.

Live-action games such as the Halloween grandeur nature werewolf (loup-garou) game at Le Secret de l'Île (Paris 4e) and the Complot à la Conciergerie participatory game offer short live role-play, but no regular LARP club was confirmed.

There is no sea coast, but river and lake clean-ups run in the Paris area, e.g. litter-collecting kayak outings at the Île de loisirs de Créteil (18 Oct) and the City of Paris Ménage ton canal campaign.
Nos Quartiers ont du Talent (NQT) and Frateli run mentoring programmes pairing professionals with young graduates and students, active in the Paris region.
